topicName: Continuous Integration and Deployment (App Center, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Continuous Integration and Deployment for Xamarin with GitHub Actions and App Center"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Automating your Xamarin mobile application build, test, and deployment pipeline is crucial for maintaining rapid delivery cycles and high code quality. In this tutorial, we will explore how to set up a robust CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions for automation and Visual Studio App Center for distribution."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Prerequisites"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"A Xamarin.Forms or Xamarin.Android/iOS project hosted in a GitHub repository."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"A Visual Studio App Center account with apps created for Android and iOS."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Basic familiarity with YAML and GitHub Actions workflows."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 1: Setting up App Center CLI and API Token"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"To allow GitHub Actions to interact with App Center, you need to generate an API token from your App Center account settings under User Settings -> API Tokens. Save this token securely as a GitHub Repository Secret named APP_CENTER_API_TOKEN."},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 2: Creating the GitHub Actions Workflow"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"Create a new file in your repository at .github/workflows/xamarin-ci.yml. This workflow will restore NuGet packages, build the Android and iOS configurations, and distribute the binaries to App Center."},{"order":11,"type":"code","text":"name: Xamarin CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Setup MSBuild
      uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v1.1

    - name: Setup NuGet
      uses: nuget/setup-nuget@v1

    - name: Restore NuGet Packages
      run: nuget restore YourSolutionName.sln

    - name: Build Xamarin.Android
      run: msbuild YourApp.Android/YourApp.Android.csproj /p:Configuration=Release /p:AndroidKeyStore=true

    - name: Distribute to App Center
      uses: wemake-services/appcenter-action@v1.4
      with:
        app-name: 'Your-App-Center-Org/Your-Android-App'
        token: ${{ secrets.APP_CENTER_API_TOKEN }}
        group: 'Collaborators'
        file: 'YourApp.Android/bin/Release/com.company.yourapp-Signed.apk'"},{"order":12,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":13,"type":"paragraph","text":"By combining GitHub Actions and Visual Studio App Center, you have successfully automated your Xamarin build and release pipeline. Every push to your main branch will now trigger a fresh build and instantly notify your testing team via App Center distribution."}]
